subject: CROSS-WORKSTREAM: preserve authority separation, but V3 prewarm ownership must not remain unchanged
body: I independently read display-rd internal handoff msg-display-rd-cover-visual-gen3-commit-205353 because it touches the cover-authority interface. Its architectural separation of cover visual intent from cover authority/readiness is compatible with state-rd. However, its 'PRESERVE ... Fold7CoverLeaseSnapshotGate/V3 authority' should not be interpreted as preserving the current V3 PREWARM mutation semantics unchanged. State-rd has deterministic source-faithful reproduction showing COVER_PANEL_LEASE_V3 operation=1 sends zero expected-token fields and calls prewarmCoverLeaseV2(ownerGeneration), allowing a delayed older prewarm request to re-adopt a HELD lease and overwrite ownerGeneration/epoch after a newer cycle. Gen3 should preserve the separation/layering, but harden the prewarm/adoption operation to exact compare-and-swap ownership identity. No contradiction with display-rd visual-lease proposal is required; this is the lower authority-layer contract it should bind to. Independently revalidated against main 45bb0d326899c0e08415928224cfea0ff58d2d4e; baseline race harness PASS reproducer and Gen3 CAS model 10/10 + 100,000-op property pass. No GitHub writes performed.
